meta.annotator: session author (assistant), reviewing the same dialogue it participated in
meta.caveat: Self-annotated corpus: labels come from the same model family that produced the conversation, so this measures consistency, not independent human agreement.
meta.note: Gold items are the argumentatively significant units; a good extraction should find these or close paraphrases. Sub-claims are acceptable matches for their parent.

decisions.label: Adopt plugin + sidecar middleware architecture over forking opencode
Keep LLM extraction in the Rust sidecar
Cover everything through responsiveness in the first implementation phase
Convert tool-call events to Evidence nodes deterministically without LLM
Batch prose events with a 15s/10-event debounce into one LLM call per batch
Use loopback binding and bearer-token auth for the engine
Read OPENAI_BASE_URL with fallback to ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL for OpenAI-compatible gateways
Add self-healing JSON-in-content mode when gateways ignore forced tool calls
Consolidate to six opencode tools instead of ten
Inject reasoning-state brief into the system prompt every turn
Make ARMIN opt-in rather than auto-enabled for all sessions
Derive deterministic node IDs from event IDs so re-ingestion is idempotent
Use poe OpenAI-compatible endpoint with GLM-5.3-flash for extraction

questions.label: Backtest extraction against this real conversation to evaluate quality
Can extraction reuse opencode's internal model and auth?
Is ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL the right env var for the poe OpenAI-compatible endpoint?
Does the poe gateway support forced tool calling?
Migrate storage from unmaintained sled to redb
Replace HTTP sidecar with a napi-rs native addon in phase 3

assumptions.label: The message.part.updated event payload shape is stable across opencode versions
A cheap flash-class model is adequate for structured extraction quality
Linux and macOS are the only platforms that matter for now

evidence.label: Plain chat completion probe against poe returned OK
Forced tool_choice probe against poe returned no tool_calls
JSON-in-content probe against poe returned valid extraction JSON
Workspace tests pass in 16 suites with zero compiler warnings
Engine smoke test verified auth, ingest, brief, query, and restart persistence
Live GLM extraction produced 4 nodes and 3 edges with zero errors

contradictions.label: Initial claim that the middleware had no opencode-config integration was contradicted after implementing file-based armin config

key_relations.note: the dropped tool call motivated the JSON fallback
JSON mode probe validated the fallback works
live extraction validated the poe/GLM choice
